name: Beggar's Haunt
summary: Forsaken agents watch the eastern approaches from Beggar's Haunt, an old Stormwind tower. It stands on a hillside in northeastern Duskwood, near the mountain road to Deadwind Pass.

sections.title: A Watchtower in the Shadows
sections.body: Beggar's Haunt looks over the hills east of Manor Mistmantle. Stormwind once kept guards here to watch the kingdom's eastern approaches. As Duskwood sank into gloom, the patrols withdrew to Darkshire and left the tower to weather and ruin. Now Forsaken agents study the region from within Alliance territory. Among them are members of the Royal Apothecary Society and the Deathstalkers.

sections.title: Knight's Hollow and the Forgotten Dead
sections.body: A winding path behind Beggar's Haunt descends to Knight's Hollow, where a secluded pool lies beneath a waterfall. An unmarked grave rests between two hooded stone statues, like the guardians beside the Dark Portal. Nearby graves include the resting place of an Unknown Soldier. These graves recall forgotten clashes along the frontier, fought long before the Forsaken took the watchtower.

faq.q: Why are there Forsaken at Beggar's Haunt?
faq.answer: Forsaken agents from the Undercity have claimed the abandoned tower. Among them are Apothecary Faustin of the Royal Apothecary Society and Deathstalker Zraedus. They watch Alliance movements and quietly conduct experiments far to the south.

faq.q: Was this tower originally built by the Forsaken?
faq.answer: No. Stormwind built the tower as a scout outpost. When local defenses faltered and the region became Duskwood, the Stormwind Guard abandoned it. Forsaken scouts later seized the empty tower.

faq.q: What is the strange grave behind the tower?
faq.answer: Knight's Hollow lies down the path behind Beggar's Haunt. At its secluded waterfall pool, an unmarked grave rests between hooded guardian statues like those beside the Dark Portal.

faq.q: Is Beggar's Haunt hostile to Alliance travelers?
faq.answer: Yes. The Forsaken agents at the tower are seasoned and strike down Alliance travelers who come too close to their hillside refuge.

angles.text: Forsaken agents in an old Stormwind scout tower just off the main road show that the Horde has reached Darkshire's doorstep.
As a Forsaken, you hold a secluded and dangerous foothold deep in the human lands of the south.
